Risk Scenario: If staff continue using unapproved consumer AI services, confidential commercial and personal data may be disclosed outside Northstar's control with no record of what was submitted.
Treatment: Block unapproved services at egress; provide sanctioned alternative; monitor and alert on attempts; amnesty period with communications

Risk Scenario: If the CV screening tool produces systematically different outcomes across protected characteristics, Northstar may discriminate unlawfully at scale and be unable to explain any individual decision.
Treatment: Vendor bias testing evidence required; human review of all rejections; explainability record per decision; classify as high-risk and apply EU AI Act obligations

Risk Scenario: If AI agents and workload identities retain broad directory permissions granted during pilots, compromise of any one may yield directory-wide access that no lifecycle process will revoke.
Treatment: Inventory all agent identities with owner; revoke to least privilege; scoped permissions per agent; quarterly review

Risk Scenario: If an agent operates without a documented authority boundary, it may take or recommend action against production financial systems outside its intended scope.
Treatment: Mandatory authority boundary per system; deployment blocked without it; boundary enforced technically not by policy

Risk Scenario: If hallucinated or unverified AI output reaches a customer, Northstar may communicate incorrect commitments on price, availability or specification.
Treatment: Mandatory human review for customer-facing output; confidence thresholds; output logging for dispute resolution

Risk Scenario: If an agent processes untrusted external content, instructions embedded in that content may cause it to act outside its intended purpose.
Treatment: Treat external content as untrusted input; separate instruction and data channels; restrict agent tool access; monitor anomalous actions

Risk Scenario: If a vendor's model provider trains on Northstar data, commercially sensitive information may be absorbed into a model serving other customers with no route to recall it.
Treatment: Contractual prohibition on training use; written opt-out evidenced before data transfer; annual confirmation; standard clause in all AI procurement

Risk Scenario: If the person who built an agent leaves and no owner is recorded, the agent continues operating with no accountability for its behaviour or its access.
Treatment: Named owner mandatory at registration; ownership transfer in leaver process; agents without owner disabled after 30 days

Risk Scenario: If a forecasting model degrades without detection, inventory and production decisions may be based on progressively wrong predictions.
Treatment: Accuracy monitoring against actuals; drift thresholds with alerting; documented retraining trigger; periodic revalidation

Risk Scenario: If Copilot surfaces content from overshared repositories, staff may access information they were never intended to see, at a speed and scale manual browsing never permitted.
Treatment: Remediate SharePoint and OneDrive oversharing before broad Copilot enablement; sensitivity labelling; restricted search scope; access review of high-risk sites

Risk Scenario: If agent actions are not logged, Northstar cannot determine what an agent did, on whose behalf, or with what data during an investigation.
Treatment: Mandatory action logging for all A1 and above; 12-month retention; logs routed to central workspace

Risk Scenario: If the CV screening tool is not treated as a high-risk AI system, Northstar may fail obligations on transparency, human oversight, record-keeping and conformity where the EU AI Act applies.
Treatment: Classify formally as high-risk; apply transparency notice, human oversight, logging and record-keeping obligations; vendor conformity evidence

Risk Scenario: If the predictive maintenance model fails silently, maintenance may be scheduled incorrectly, causing unplanned plant downtime.
Treatment: Fallback to schedule-based maintenance on model unavailability; accuracy monitoring; engineer override always available

Risk Scenario: If personal data is included in prompts without lawful basis, Northstar may process personal data outside the purposes for which it was collected.
Treatment: Data protection impact assessment per system; prompt data minimisation guidance; technical controls on sensitive data categories; lawful basis recorded

Risk Scenario: If one agent can invoke another, a chain of individually bounded agents may produce a combined privilege path that no single assessment reviewed.
Treatment: Map agent-to-agent invocation; assess combined privilege of any chain; prohibit chaining across sensitivity boundaries without review

Risk Scenario: If inference consumption is uncontrolled, AI spend may escalate without corresponding business value or budget visibility.
Treatment: Consumption budgets per system with alerting; value review at each renewal
